Counsel for the petitioners informs that the petitioners BGP. 1 of 2 (2)-WP-3333-23 &
3726-22.doc.
are connected through virtual mode.
3. The respondent No.2/complainant is present in the Court.
Petitioner/husband has placed on record an affidavit thereby undertaking that an amount of Rs.7,00,000/- shall be deposited in the pending divorce proceedings within period of two weeks from today.

A statement is also made in the said affidavit that the locker with Axis Bank, Dindoshi Branch shall be jointly operated by the petitioner/husband and the respondent No.2/complainant and after drawing an inventory of the jewellery, Stridhan shall be returned to the respondent No.2/complainant which process shall be completed within two weeks from today.
4. Stand over to 30th October, 2023, for reporting compliance.
